# Cafe24
> Korea-based e-commerce platform for launching, operating, marketing, and scaling online stores across domestic and global channels.

Cafe24 provides storefront creation, design tools, sales channel integrations, store management features, dropshipping, and enterprise commerce solutions for creators, founders, marketplace sellers, and global merchants.

## Getting Started
- [인플루언서(크리에이터)](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/influencer.html): Creator-focused commerce setup for selling products through personal brand channels.
- [신규 창업자](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/founder.html): Starter path for new merchants launching their first online store.
- [오픈마켓 셀러](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/market-seller.html): Onboarding guidance for sellers expanding from marketplaces to owned storefronts.
- [글로벌 판매](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/global-sales.html): Introduction to cross-border commerce and international store operations.
- [기업형 맞춤 제작](https://www.cafe24.com/enterprise/main.html): Enterprise commerce solutions for large brands requiring tailored implementations.

## Design & Storefront
- [기능/서비스 소개](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/): Overview of storefront design capabilities and visual customization tools.
- [무료 디자인 템플릿](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/theme.html): Free store themes and templates for quickly launching branded shops.
- [스마트디자인Easy](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/smart-easy.html): Simplified design editor for merchants building pages without complex coding.
- [스마트디자인](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/smart.html): Advanced storefront design system for deeper layout and UI customization.
- [고객 사례](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/reference-mall.html): Example stores demonstrating design implementations and storefront quality.

## Sales Channels & Integrations
- [기능/서비스 소개](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/channel/): Overview of multichannel sales and external platform integrations.
- [오픈마켓](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/channel/market.html): Connect and manage sales across major open marketplace platforms.
- [네이버](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/channel/naver.html): Integration details for selling through Naver commerce channels.
- [카카오](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/channel/kakao.html): Commerce connection options for Kakao-based customer acquisition and sales.
- [페이스북ㆍ인스타그램](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/channel/facebook.html): Social commerce integration for Facebook and Instagram storefront promotion.
- [구글](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/channel/google.html): Google-related sales and advertising channel integration for merchants.

## Store Management
- [기능/서비스 소개](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/manage/): Overview of operational tools for running and administering an online store.
- [쇼핑몰 기본 정보 설정](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/manage/basic.html): Configure core store settings, business information, and operational basics.

## Dropshipping
- [재고 없는 상품 소싱](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/dropshipping/dropshipping-seller.html): Dropshipping workflow for sourcing products without holding inventory.
- [드랍쉬핑 공급 입점](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/dropshipping/dropshipping-supply.html): Supplier participation page for listing products in Cafe24 dropshipping programs.

## Enterprise
- [기업형 맞춤 제작](https://www.cafe24.com/enterprise/main.html): Custom enterprise storefront builds and scalable commerce infrastructure for large organizations.

## Audience-Specific Solutions
- [인플루언서(크리에이터)](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/influencer.html): Commerce tools tailored to influencers and creator-led product sales.
- [신규 창업자](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/founder.html): Resources for first-time founders building direct-to-consumer storefronts.
- [오픈마켓 셀러](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/market-seller.html): Support for marketplace merchants transitioning to independent commerce.
- [글로벌 판매](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/start/global-sales.html): Solutions for merchants targeting international customers and overseas markets.

## Reference & Examples
- [고객 사례](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/reference-mall.html): Real storefront examples showing how merchants use Cafe24 design features.
- [무료 디자인 템플릿](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/theme.html): Ready-made templates useful for evaluating storefront design options.
- [스마트디자인Easy](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/smart-easy.html): Entry-level design tooling for rapid storefront prototyping and launch.
- [스마트디자인](https://www.cafe24.com/commerce/design/smart.html): Advanced design environment for more customized storefront implementations.
